title: Implementation project
description: An implementation project (PRJ). R1 owns the project record, not the customer master: customer_reference and customer_label only point to and name the customer organization; R1 holds no customer legal, CRM, billing, or contract record and no personal data. Examples are illustrative examples using synthetic data.

project_id.description: Unique ID of the implementation project.

customer_reference.description: Free-form reference to the customer record in whatever system the adopting organization uses (for example SYN-CUSTOMER-A in synthetic data). It is not an R1 ID and R1 does not own or validate the record it points to. null means known to be absent.

customer_label.description: Human-readable display label for the customer organization, such as Synthetic Organization A. Never a person's name and never personal data.

current_phase_id.description: The phase instance the project is in now. It must belong to this project.

project_status.description: The authoritative project status vocabulary. It is defined here and nowhere else.

org_stage.description: Organization stage from standard/org-stages.yaml, chosen by a person.

project_owner_role_id.description: Role that owns the project. A role, not a person, so one person may hold several roles.

target_launch_date.description: Planned launch date, where the project has one. A person sets it; nothing predicts it.

actual_launch_date.description: Date the system was put into use. Empty until launch.

external_reference.description: Optional free-form reference to another system's record, such as an intake form number. Not an R1 ID.

created_at.description: When the project record was created (UTC).

updated_at.description: When the project record last changed (UTC).

schema_version.description: Version of the R1 core record schemas (0.1.0). Events carry the shared standard version instead.
